App.Title: PS1Run — PowerShell Script Launcher
Hint.Association: Registration is written to the current user (HKCU\Software\Classes); machine-wide registration needs administrator approval. Windows “Default apps” is controlled by UserChoice and must be confirmed manually once.
Hint.AutoSaved: Changes apply immediately; no need to save.
Hint.Executor: Auto mode: UTF-8 / UTF-16 go to PS7, ANSI (GBK) goes to PS5. If missing, specify the paths below.
Hint.LogDays: Expired logs are pruned automatically on the first run of each day (1–365).
Hint.RunMode: The context-menu entries “Run / Edit” are explicit intents and always bypass “Ask”.
Hint.Version: Version numbers tell whether the config file and language pack match this build.
